$comment: Generated from the BuildingEase CMF schema (structure version 1). Do not edit by hand.
title: BuildingEase CMF Structure
description: A product's Common Materials Framework (CMF) structure, schema version 1. Every field is a list of { value, source } records; a record's source names an entry in the top-level sources list (or is null). Fields and sections with no data are omitted. Every non-null record source must match the name of an entry in sources; JSON Schema cannot express that rule, so validate it separately.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the CMF structure this document follows. Increases whenever the structure changes.

sources.description: Every data source referenced by a field in this document, one entry per unique name.

updatedTimestamp.description: When this document was generated (ISO 8601, UTC).

impactAreas.description: The CMF fields, grouped by impact area.

substances.description: Applies to the product. Substances are defined by the EPA as any organic or inorganic substance of a particular molecular identity. The CMF includes factors such as percentage of disclosure, disclosure granularity, restricted substance lists, and class-based chemical avoidance.

sourceRef.description: Name of the entry in the top-level `sources` list this value came from, or null when the value is not attributed to a data source.
